letters.text:
SCDA 2027 - Symposium on Circuit Design Automation
Centre des Congres de Lyon, Lyon, 26 April 2027 to 29 April 2027

Lyon, 8 March 2027

To the Consular Section concerned,

This letter confirms that Mr. Mingyu ZHOU, born 12 March 1998, citizen of the People's Republic of China, is a registered author of SCDA 2027 (registration SCDA27-R-0388, fee paid). SCDA 2027 takes place at the Centre des Congres de Lyon, Lyon, from 26 April 2027 to 29 April 2027.

Mr. ZHOU will present paper #214, "Learned Placement Priors for Analog Layout Migration", in Session 9B (Analog Layout) on Thursday 29 April 2027, 16:00-17:30.

The organizers do not cover travel, accommodation or living expenses of participants.

Prof. Claire Moreau
General Chair, SCDA 2027

notices.title: SCDA 2027 author registration SCDA27-R-0388 confirmed
notices.body:
Dear Mr. ZHOU Mingyu,

Your author registration SCDA27-R-0388 for SCDA 2027 is complete. Paper #214, "Learned Placement Priors for Analog Layout Migration", stays in the program.

Author rate: USD 720.00, paid with First Prairie Visa ending 2291. It covers: Attendance at all sessions, 26-29 April 2027; Publication of one accepted paper in the proceedings; Lunches and coffee breaks; Welcome reception on 26 April 2027.

Your visa invitation letter is issued 10 business days after registration, on 2027-03-08, using the details on file. Corrections can be requested in ConfDesk.

SCDA 2027 Registration Desk
